description.narrative: Connect for bigger impact By 2030 we need to have ensured that everyone has access to enough nutritious food to prosper. Changing the food system to make this possible, is a collective effort that needs innovative and willing people from all sectors involved. Netherlands Food Partnership (NFP) enables collective impact coalitions of Dutch and international partners who aim to achieve these urgent changes. We believe that transformation can only succeed by inspiring one another to adopt a wider perspective, by challenging one another, and by thinking out of the box. NFP brings together multiple stakeholders to drive food system changes in Low and Middle Income countries, notably in Africa, Asia and the Middle East.
